scope: Line-by-line re-verification of every published row across the OLBG lines track (data/matches.json, 137 rows), the board track (data/events.json 114 events, data/master_matches.json 76 rows) and the official feed track (data/current.json 40 rows), plus claim-level checks of all 10 published high-confidence predictions.
method: Every row must carry a source link to the OLBG listing it was transcribed from (checked programmatically: 137/137).

A field is filled only when a cited source states it explicitly. Where no official/primary source could be retrieved in this pass, competition/venue/start stay blank and the row is flagged (never inferred).

Live verification on 2026-10-21 against official bodies: NBA.com, NHL.com, MLB.com, ATP Tour, WTA, EuroLeague TV / BKT EuroCup, EHFCL, LNR (Pro D2 / Top 14), URC match centre, ICE Hockey League (ice.hockey / eishockey.at / EC-KAC), SHL, PZPS PlusLiga, VfB Friedrichshafen (Bundesliga), snooker.org / WST, ICC, ESPNcricinfo fixtures board, CSA fixture list, PGA Tour event site, LPGA, Formula1.com, PDC.
Each newly verified record stores the exact source ids in data/verifications.json (event_verifications); tools/build_dataset.py copies them into data/matches.json and the site renders them per row.

summary.blank_fields_policy: A value is written only when a cited source states it. Unverified rows keep null competition/venue/start and appear in the Flagged for Review register (FL-022).

board_track.note: board track rows in data/master_matches.json (76) and data/events.json (114) all carry official_source_url / verification blocks; 4 flags in data/flagged_review.json
